entries.04716972b1afe8ad: This business operates convenience stores, centered on 7-Eleven, Inc., in North America, Australia, China and other regions, under both directly operated and franchise systems. Directly operated stores sell processed foods, fast food, daily-delivered foods, and non-food products, and also sell gasoline to visiting customers and dealers. From franchisees, it receives royalties based on each store’s gross profit, as consideration for a bundled set of services comprising trademark and other licensing, training, pre-opening preparation, advertising, management guidance, and licensing of land, buildings and equipment.

entries.9d8523c8876dbe8d: This business operates convenience stores in Japan under company-operated and franchise models, centered on Seven-Eleven Japan Co., Ltd. To franchised stores, it provides as a single inseparable service the licensing of business know-how and trademarks, equipment leasing, purchasing cooperation, advertising, management consulting, credit for merchandise purchases, pre-opening support, training, and accounting and bookkeeping services, and it receives royalties according to each store's gross profit.

The securities report states: “The company is mainly engaged in the Domestic Convenience Store Business and the Overseas Convenience Store Business.”
